items.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
items.lead_paragraph: Across recruiting, engineering, and operations, Oracle turns specialist knowledge into fast, repeatable workflows with ChatGPT Work and Codex.

items.title: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
items.lead_paragraph: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

items.title: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
items.lead_paragraph: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.

items.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

items.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
items.lead_paragraph: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

items.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
items.lead_paragraph: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

items.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
items.lead_paragraph: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.

items.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
items.lead_paragraph: Jump Trading uses OpenAI to expand quantitative research. See how longer-running AI workflows combine multiple data sources with human review.

items.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

items.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
items.lead_paragraph: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

items.title: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
items.lead_paragraph: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

items.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
items.lead_paragraph: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.

items.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

items.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
items.lead_paragraph: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.
